# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.18 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.17 (6 commits). Most of this comes from one tester's list (a Windows 11 user). It was written and tested by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; **the GUI changes were not tried in a window, and nothing was tried on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Rotation (tester: "rotate jumps from 90° to 180°")**
- A sheet turned by hand with the rotate buttons (or ±45°) is now **locked**: neither the built-in sideways check nor Tesseract's OSD is applied on top of it, even at 0°. Before, the automatic turn was added to the user's turn, and 0° could not be chosen because automatic orientation came back there. Reset unlocks. In projects: `orient-locked = 1`.
- Not confirmed on the reporter's machine: on Linux, both detectors left the reported page (a photo with one caption line) upright. The fix removes the stacking whichever detector misfires; ROADMAP 4.40.

**Drawing on the original (GUI)**
- New **Work area**: drag a rectangle; everything outside it is painted with the paper colour before anything is measured. New **Cut line**: click or drag a vertical line; a two-page sheet is cut there instead of at the gutter or the middle (sheets not turned, or turned 180°). Right-click removes each. Both are per sheet, with undo.
- Erase and picture zones can be resized by dragging a corner.
- The point grid no longer doubles when its button is pressed twice; "Output dpi" sits under "JPEG quality"; the zoom slider is hidden while "Fit" is on.
- Command line: `--work-area X,Y,W,H` (mm) and `--cut-at FRACTION`; projects: `work =`, `split-at =`.

**Build without the compiled-in OCR model**
- `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features lexicon` leaves out `multi.lnm` (rights to part of its training data are unresolved, `docs/audit/assets-licences.md`). `--doctor` then reports the native engine as missing and OCR needs Tesseract or an external engine. The whole test suite passes this way and CI now runs it. Release archives still contain the model.

**Documents**
- User guide (Romanian, in progress) written as an editable document; not in the repository yet.

Still open: Windows, macOS and arm64 tests by other people; rights to the model's training data; PDF/UA, e-Factura CIUS-RO and a real HTTPS time-stamp authority; package recipes unsubmitted.
